sonnet.problem: This story card only repeats verse 3 (Judah and Simeon teaming up) and adds a joke. It tells no new part of the passage, so it does not move the baker forward and works as a recap card.
sonnet.rule: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. ... No recap cards. ... Every story card tells part of the passage. Jokes ride along on those cards.

sonnet.problem: The question asks what has happened to Adoni-bezek now, but two answers don't fit it. 'His own gods will avenge him soon' is a future claim, and 'Judah is crueler than he ever was' is not something that happened to him. In the second answer, 'he' could mean Judah or Adoni-bezek.
sonnet.rule: Clear English. Every card reads correctly. Each answer fits its question: ... "He," "she" and "they" always point to someone the baker can tell.
